images.description: Workers on a coffee plantation at Kuranda, Queensland, ca. 1900. Workers, including some South Sea Islanders, on a coffee plantation at Kuranda, Queensland, ca. 1900. The group poses standing among the rows of coffee bean trees. Trees border the field in the background. Agriculture and timber harvesting have greatly pushed down the forest in these areas also contributes to soil degradation. Ref 20
